info.author: Yorts
info.name: flarevel
info.summary: Flarevel is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that quickly scaffolds Flask projects with a robust Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture. It generates a well-organized project structure, including dedicated folders for models, views, controllers, and configurations, enabling developers to start building scalable and maintainable Flask applications in no time. Flarevel streamlines the setup process, saving you time and ensuring a clean, modular foundation for your projects.
